result.title: Continual Tool-Space Extension Learning for Multimodal Agents
result.summary: Multimodal agents largely rely on generic tools such as cropping, search, and code execution, leaving specialist vision models outside their tool space. However, bringing such a model into an already trained agent is not straightforward. The challenge is to learn each new tool efficiently while retaining the ability to use existing ones. This work proposes COTEX, continual tool-space extension learning, that adds new tools at efficient adapter-level cost. COTEX locates two sets of parameter directions; one triggers a tool call and thereby opens a multi-turn reasoning trajectory, while the other determines which tool is chosen. The adapter of a new tool is restricted to the calling directions that leave earlier tool choices unaffected by orthogonal constraint. We further introduce a protocol that converts specialist models' existing task-specific annotations into verified tool-use trajectories. Experiments on two representative agents and three specialist tools show gains on ten vision-language benchmarks, with at most a 0.3-point drop on existing tools.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 COTEX，通过在 adapter 层定位两组参数方向——一组触发工具调用并开启多轮推理轨迹，另一组决定选择哪个工具——以低代价为多模态 agent 增量加入专家视觉模型，并用正交约束使新工具不影响既有工具的调用选择；同时给出把专家模型已有任务标注转成可验证工具使用轨迹的流程。
AI.relevance_reason: 把工具调用触发与工具选择拆成可定位的参数方向，以及构造可验证工具使用轨迹的做法，可能为 LOOK/证据获取决策与轨迹监督提供借鉴；但论文目标是持续扩展工具空间、缓解遗忘，未涉及 latent 推理状态如何生成与使用，需阅读原文核查其轨迹与触发机制能否迁移。
